$schema-comment: Manifest for Windows-bundled binaries. Each entry describes one .exe (and its DLLs) that ships under vendor/windows/bin/.
$layout-comment: All extracted .exe + .dll files MUST land directly in vendor/windows/bin/ (no nested subdirectories) so dosforge._platform.windows can resolve them with a single Path.join.

components.name: qemu
components.description: QEMU for Windows (Stefan Weil's official x86_64 build). Provides qemu-img.exe and qemu-system-i386.exe used for VHD creation and DOS SYS install.

components.name: mtools
components.description: MSYS2 mingw-w64 mtools package — provides mformat.exe, mcopy.exe, mattrib.exe, mdir.exe used for FAT12/16 system-file staging.

$notes: Run scripts/fetch-windows-vendor.py to populate vendor/windows/bin/ on a developer or CI machine.
The exact version_pin, download_url, and expected_sha256 fields must be populated before the fetch script will succeed. See vendor/windows/README.md for the recommended values for v0.3.0.
vendor/windows/bin/ is .gitignore'd — binaries are fetched at build time, not committed.
